The printed Ge'ez text clearly reads ግብረ (accusative of ግብር, matching ወዘንተ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ግብረ in Col 3 L05-06 and the Amharic translation ይህን ፡ በጎውን ፡ ሥራ in Col 4 L34-35), which was misread as ግበሪ due to slight ink wear on ብ and ረ.
The canonical Ge'ez noun for 'partakers/fellowship' is ሱታፌ (5th order ፌ), which is clearly visible in the image (the bottom ring of ፌ was misread as the top loop of ፎ).

Across the line wrap (L19-L20), the word is ተሁት (contracted form of ተውሁት, 'I left it'), with 1st order ተ clearly visible at the end of Line 19.
As in Line 19-20, the printed word is ተሁት ('I left it', from ተወ), with 1st order ተ rather than 6th order ት.
